metadata.name: Path of Ruin: Nehemiah's Usurpance
metadata.description:
Journey through The Basement as Nehemiah, a new character for Isaac to cosplay.
[h1] Nehemiah [/h1] [img] temp [/img]
Play The Binding of Isaac: Repentance with a new twist! Nehemiah is a rock focused character, carving rocks to get chunks that deal big damage. With Isaac's new toy, "Nehemiah's Hammer", you can unlock the true potential of your runs, mingling with shops and secrets...
[h1] Tainted Nehemiah ("The Condemned") [/h1] [img] temp [/img]
When playing as Tainted Nehemiah, Isaac loses his signature hammer, in favor of an old locked book. This new item, "The Book of Ezra", gives Isaac a fading buff when standing in the light it shines. Be careful, however, because Tainted Nehemiah has the power to draw out this book's latent potential, and so does the book for Nehemiah.
[h1] Unlockables [/h1]
I have big plkans for this mod! Right away there aren't any unlocks, but I will definitely add unlocks for both characters!
I also would like to release more content in multiple waves, but can't promise anything since I'm the only programmer.
